sales.name: Total Sales (Bruto/Netto)
sales.calculation: SUM(total_netto) for net sales, SUM(total_dpp) for gross base price. All in IDR.
sales.description: Standard measure of revenue generated from sales across all branches.

gpn.name: Gross Profit Nominal
gpn.calculation: GPN = Total Sales - COGS (Cost of Goods Sold). Field in DB: 'gpn'.
gpn.description: The absolute profit margin before operating expenses.

gpm.name: Gross Profit Margin (%)
gpm.calculation: GPM = (GPN / Total Sales) * 100. Field in DB: 'gpm'.
gpm.description: Percentage efficiency of profit margin. High GPM indicates healthy pricing strategy.

stock_turnover.name: Inventory Turnover
stock_turnover.calculation: COGS / Average Inventory. Higher is better.
stock_turnover.description: Indicates how many times the company has sold and replaced its inventory during a specific period.

business_rules.tax: VAT (PPN) is generally included in 'total_netto' but excluded from 'total_dpp'.
